Let \(a=\sqrt[4]{5^4+1}\) and \(b=\sqrt[4]{5^4-1}\). Then
\[
a^4-b^4=2
\]
and
\[
a^4-b^4=(a-b)(a+b)(a^2+b^2).
\]
So
\[
\frac1{a-b}=\frac{(a+b)(a^2+b^2)}2.
\]

Write \(a=5(1+x)^{1/4}\), \(b=5(1-x)^{1/4}\) with \(x=\frac1{625}\). Using binomial approximations:
\[
a+b\approx 10-\frac{15}{16}x^2,\qquad
a^2+b^2=25\left((1+x)^{1/2}+(1-x)^{1/2}\right)\approx 50-\frac{25}{4}x^2.
\]
Thus
\[
\frac1{a-b}\approx \frac12\left(10-\frac{15}{16}x^2\right)\left(50-\frac{25}{4}x^2\right)
\approx 249.99986.
\]
The closest integer is therefore
\[
\boxed{250}.
\]
